article: Local RAG: Retrieve and Answer from Your Own Documents
scope: Compared the Japanese source and all twelve complete translations, model claims, cosine formula, ANN indexing, privacy statements, Python setup and code, memory/context guidance, metadata, and external links.
findings: Replaced the old LangChain RetrievalQA/Ollama wrapper with direct current Chroma, Sentence Transformers, pypdf, and Ollama Python APIs.
Added multilingual-E5 query and passage prefixes, token limit context, local persistence, page metadata, and removal of stale chunks on re-indexing.
Qualified privacy, retrieval quality, HNSW latency, embedding dimensions, and GPU memory claims.
Updated metadata, explanations, caveats, and official reference links in every language.
